LanguageData.MT_ModularBattery.label: modular battery
LanguageData.MT_ModularBattery.description: An upgradeable, weatherproof 3x3 battery with a central 1x3 body and two 1x3 side-module slots. Base storage is 1,200 Wd and charging efficiency is 80%. Each base upgrade costs 80 steel and 2 industrial components and adds 1,200 Wd before storage-module bonuses.
LanguageData.MT_BatteryGenerationModule.label: battery self-generation module
LanguageData.MT_BatteryGenerationModule.description: Generate 1/100 of effective storage capacity in Wd per day, at least 25 W per module. Each upgrade level adds 25% of this base output, up to level V. Upgrade levels follow the physical module when it is removed and installed again.
LanguageData.MT_BatteryStorageModule.label: battery high-capacity storage module
LanguageData.MT_BatteryStorageModule.description: Add 10,000 Wd of storage and increase the capacity gained from each base upgrade by 50%. These bonuses add per installed copy. Install in either battery side slot. This battery module has no upgrades.
LanguageData.MT_BatteryCoilModule.label: battery wireless power module
LanguageData.MT_BatteryCoilModule.description: Supply electrical consumers within 40 cells through the battery power network without connecting wires. Each upgrade adds 5 cells of range, up to 65 cells at level V. Upgrade levels follow the physical module when it is removed and installed again.
LanguageData.MT_BatteryProtectionModule.label: battery surge protection module
LanguageData.MT_BatteryProtectionModule.description: Protect this battery's stored electricity from power-network short circuits and prevent component breakdowns. Does not protect against solar flares. Install in either battery side slot. This battery module has no upgrades.
LanguageData.MT_BatteryReserveModule.label: battery emergency reserve module
LanguageData.MT_BatteryReserveModule.description: Store an additional 20% of ordinary capacity as emergency reserve. Charge it from surplus electricity and release it when the network is short of power. Two copies keep the same reserve fraction. Install in either battery side slot. This battery module has no upgrades.
LanguageData.MT_BatteryEfficiencyModule.label: battery charging-efficiency module
LanguageData.MT_BatteryEfficiencyModule.description: Set charging efficiency to 100%. One installed copy provides the full effect. Install in either battery side slot. This battery module has no upgrades.
